PHL.rule: free units at or over 20 people a km2 (or holding 400,000), grouped in their region until each zone holds 500,000 (or 100,000 over 100,000 km2): under 100,000 into the zone it travels with most, then a neighbour keeping both within 1,500,000 that is a travel partner (50% of its biggest partner's travel), else one making a compact zone (75% of its convex hull, or within 0.05 of the bigger part's) unless both hold an urban centre of 100,000 (T-1191), partners first, each by nearest people centre, whose union wraps no zone, metro or pack (T-1140, T-1087); under 400,000 another region's passing neighbour when its own region has none; nothing passing, it stays; islands the most populous zone within 150 km (10 km from 100,000); then each zone still wrapping one cut across it and its halves regrouped; travel by gravity on GHSL people (20 km cells, within 200 km); unbuilt metros first take touching units under 100,000 whose biggest partner they are, when the grown metro wraps nothing new (T-1191)
